headline: Labor sector demands 15% increase in minimum wage for 2027 and calls for eliminating the MIR
summary: The labour sector proposed a 15% increase in the general and professional minimum wages for 2027. It also called for the elimination of the MIR, saying the current model compresses incomes at the base of the pyramid.
why: Minimum wage decisions in Mexico affect labour costs for retailers and manufacturers and influence consumer spending.
original_headline: Sector obrero exige alza de 15% al salario mínimo para 2027 y pide eliminar el MIR
